focus: Practical software engineering, scientific research tools, and automation across sectors
title: From Market Mood to Observable Systems: Building Trustworthy Sentiment Workflows
utility_use_case: After a research or trading-system batch, run the utility on the application log to summarize severity counts and lines matching a failure pattern. This helps an operator notice an operational change without copying potentially sensitive message text into a notebook or report. Treat the summary as a triage aid: investigate the source logs through approved access controls, and assess model validity with separate tests.

editorial_review.summary: The worked example arithmetic and the documented CLI behavior match the supplied data and executable source. Corrected the memory bound to account for the line held during processing.

edits.old: memory beyond the regex and counters is $O(k)$, where $k$ is the number of distinct severity labels, bounded by the fixed severity set.
edits.new: memory beyond the regex and counters is $O(k + L)$, where $k$ is the number of distinct severity labels, bounded by the fixed severity set, and $L$ is the length of the longest input line.
